statement.p: Suppose V = f(t) is the speed in km/hr of an accelerating car t seconds after starting.
Which of the statements best explains the meaning of the INVERSE function f^{-1} ?

li.p: The number of seconds it takes a car to reach a speed of V km/hr.
The velocity of a car t seconds after accelerating.
How long after leaving the car has an acceleration of V km per second squared.
The acceleration of a car which is going V km/hr.

static.solution:
SOLUTION
The inverse function, f^{-1}(V), gives the time, in seconds after leaving, at which the speed is V \ \mbox{km/hr}.
